basic_details.job_title: UP Anganwadi Worker Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 201 Posts in Sonbhadra District
basic_details.short_information: The Office of the District Programme Officer, Child Development (Bal Vikas), Sonbhadra has released the UP Anganwadi Karyakartri Notification 2026 on 05 August 2026 on the official website https://upanganwadibharti.in. A total of 201 vacancies have been announced for the post of Anganwadi Karyakartri (Anganwadi Worker) under the UP Anganwadi Karyakartri Recruitment 2026.

how_to_apply: Candidates must apply online only, through the official departmental website.
Locate and open the online application format for Anganwadi Karyakartri, Sonbhadra.
Fill in personal, educational, residence, and category details carefully.
Upload self-attested, clear, and legible scanned copies of required documents (income certificate, caste certificate, residence certificate, etc., in the applicant's own name).
Verify all entries, especially certificate numbers, before final submission.

content_sections.heading: UP Anganwadi Karyakartri Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: Vacancies are distributed project-wise across Sonbhadra district, with reservation as per SC/ST/OBC/UR categories.

content_sections.heading: UP Anganwadi Karyakartri Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility for UP Anganwadi Karyakartri Recruitment 2026 is based on gender, residency, qualification, and age, as detailed below. Only female candidates are eligible to apply. The applicant must be a resident of the same Gram Sabha (village) or urban ward for which the post is vacant. This is stated as mandatory in the notification.

content_sections.heading: UP Anganwadi Karyakartri Qualification
content_sections.text: As per the notification, the minimum educational qualification for Anganwadi Karyakartri is Intermediate (12th) or its equivalent. Candidates with qualifications up to postgraduate level may also apply, and merit will be prepared based on the percentage of marks obtained in the qualifying examination up to postgraduate level. Marks obtained in High School (10th) will not be counted toward merit.

content_sections.heading: UP Anganwadi Karyakartri Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum age: 18 years Maximum age: 35 years Age reckoning date: 01 July 2026 Age will be determined based on the date of birth recorded in the High School mark sheet/certificate. Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

content_sections.heading: UP Anganwadi Karyakartri Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for Anganwadi Karyakartri follows a merit-and-priority system rather than a written exam, as per the notification: Merit is prepared based on the percentage of marks obtained from Intermediate up to postgraduate qualification (High School marks excluded). Within the same Gram Sabha/ward, priority order is given as follows: First, widowed women from families living below the poverty line (BPL) in that Gram Sabha/ward. Next, legally divorced or deserted women from BPL families in the same Gram Sabha/ward. If no such candidate is available, other women from BPL families in the same Gram Sabha/ward. If BPL candidates are unavailable in the above categories, the same order of priority (widowed, then divorced/deserted, then general) applies to women from families above the poverty line in the same Gram Sabha/ward. As per an existing government order, two women from the same family cannot be appointed to Anganwadi Karyakartri and Anganwadi Sahayika posts at the same centre. Residence and caste certificates must be digitally signed and verifiable online; income certificates must be issued by a competent authority as per applicable government orders.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UP Anganwadi Karyakartri Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must apply online only, through the official departmental website. Visit the official website: upanganwadibharti.in Locate and open the online application format for Anganwadi Karyakartri, Sonbhadra. Fill in personal, educational, residence, and category details carefully. Upload self-attested, clear, and legible scanned copies of required documents (income certificate, caste certificate, residence certificate, etc., in the applicant's own name). Verify all entries, especially certificate numbers, before final submission. Submit the application within the window of 06 August 2026 to 26 August 2026 (till midnight). Applications submitted offline or by post will not be accepted. If any information or document is found incorrect or fabricated during verification, the candidature will be rejected. Applicants searching for openings closer to the NCR region can check Anganwadi Govt. Jobs 2026 for upcoming vacancies. faq.question: Q1. What is UP Anganwadi Karyakartri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the District Programme Officer, Child Development (Bal Vikas), Sonbhadra, to fill 201 vacant posts of Anganwadi Karyakartri (Anganwadi Worker) across eight projects in the district.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are 201 total vacancies: 56 SC, 7 ST, 53 OBC, and 85 UR, distributed across Bamni, Chatra, Chopan, Duddhi, Ghorawal, Myorpur, Nagwa, and Robertsganj projects.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The online application window closes on 26 August 2026 at midnight (12:00 AM).

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: Minimum qualification is Intermediate (12th) or equivalent; candidates up to postgraduate level can apply, with merit based on marks percentage (excluding High School marks).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 35 years of age as on 01 July 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee is not specified in the notification.
